title: Image Processing Module
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of image processing functionalities, including core utilities for common transformations and specialized processors tailored for various models. It supports both PIL and Torchvision backends for efficient image manipulation and prepares data for diverse computer vision tasks.

nodes.label: Raw Image Input
nodes.title: Raw Image Input
nodes.description: Represents raw image data provided to the processing pipeline, typically in formats like PIL Image, NumPy array, or PyTorch Tensor.

nodes.label: Base Image Utilities
nodes.title: ImageFeatureExtractionMixin
nodes.description: Provides fundamental image manipulation methods such as resizing, cropping, normalization, and format conversion, serving as a base for image processors.

nodes.label: Convert to RGB Format
nodes.title: convert_to_rgb
nodes.description: A utility function to ensure images are in RGB format, handling transparency blending for RGBA images if necessary.

nodes.label: GPU-Accelerated Processing
nodes.title: TorchvisionBackend
nodes.description: Offers a fast, batched image processing backend leveraging Torchvision for operations like resizing, padding, and normalization, optimized for GPU execution.

nodes.label: Chameleon Processor (TV)
nodes.title: ChameleonImageProcessor
nodes.description: Specialized image processor for the Chameleon model, extending the Torchvision backend with custom RGB conversion and resizing logic.

nodes.label: Chameleon Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: ChameleonImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Specialized image processor for the Chameleon model, using the PIL backend with custom RGB conversion for image preparation.

nodes.label: Conditional DETR Processor
nodes.title: ConditionalDetrImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for Conditional DETR, handling resizing, padding, normalization, and annotation preparation/post-processing for object detection and segmentation.

nodes.label: Deformable DETR Processor
nodes.title: DeformableDetrImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for Deformable DETR, including image transformations and annotation handling for object detection tasks.

nodes.label: DETR Image Processor
nodes.title: DetrImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for DETR, providing image transformations and annotation handling for object detection and segmentation tasks.

nodes.label: EfficientLoFTR Processor
nodes.title: EfficientLoFTRImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for EfficientLoFTR, focusing on image pair preprocessing (resize, rescale, grayscale) and keypoint matching post-processing.

nodes.label: GroundingDino Processor
nodes.title: GroundingDinoImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for GroundingDino, supporting image transformations, annotation preparation, and object detection post-processing.

nodes.label: Idefics2 Image Processor
nodes.title: Idefics2ImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for Idefics2, featuring image splitting, resizing, padding, and normalization for multi-image inputs.

nodes.label: LightGlue Image Processor
nodes.title: LightGlueImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for LightGlue, handling image pair preprocessing (resize, rescale, grayscale) and keypoint matching post-processing.

nodes.label: Mllama Image Processor
nodes.title: MllamaImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for Mllama, implementing unique resizing, padding, and tiling logic for multi-image inputs based on aspect ratios.

nodes.label: Nougat Image Processor
nodes.title: NougatImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for Nougat, including margin cropping, long axis alignment, thumbnail generation, and padding for document images.

nodes.label: SuperGlue Image Processor
nodes.title: SuperGlueImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: PIL-based image processor for SuperGlue, handling image pair preprocessing (resize, rescale, grayscale) and keypoint matching post-processing.

nodes.label: Processed Image Batch
nodes.title: Processed Image Batch
nodes.description: Represents a batch of images that have undergone preprocessing, ready to be fed into a machine learning model.

nodes.label: Model-Specific Output
nodes.title: Model-Specific Output
nodes.description: Structured output from model post-processing, such as detected objects, segmentation masks, or keypoint matches, tailored to specific model tasks.
